description: This Java source file defines the TenantAmqpEndpoint class, which is part of the Eclipse Hono project. It implements an AMQP endpoint for managing tenant information, including authorization checks, message handling, and integration with Vert.x environment for processing tenant-related requests over the message bus.

classes.name: TenantAmqpEndpoint
classes.description: A request-response AMQP endpoint class for tenant management, handling authorization, message creation, and response filtering within the Eclipse Hono framework. Extends RequestResponseEndpoint with specific logic for tenant-related requests.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the endpoint, used for identification, based on TenantConstants.TENANT_ENDPOINT.

methods.name: getEventBusServiceAddress
methods.description: Provides the specific event bus address for tenant messaging, defined as RegistryManagementConstants.EVENT_BUS_ADDRESS_TENANT_IN.

methods.name: isAuthorized
methods.description: Checks if a client is authorized to invoke an operation on a resource, including tenant ID extraction and delegating to the authorization service.

methods.name: filterResponse
methods.description: Verifies that the response contains only tenant information the client is authorized to access, throwing a 403 error if not authorized.

methods.name: createEventBusRequestMessage
methods.description: Creates an EventBusMessage from an AMQP request message, wrapping the message contents suitably for processing.

methods.name: passesFormalVerification
methods.description: Verifies if a message passes formal verification by using TenantMessageFilter.verify.

methods.name: getAmqpReply
methods.description: Generates an AMQP reply message for a given EventBusMessage, specific to tenant endpoints.

methods.name: isValidReplyToAddress
methods.description: Checks if a reply-to address has at least two resource segments, indicating validity for tenant responses.
